tips.text: Level it in a public match: bring a frame and one strong weapon, keep the MK1-Bo slotted, and collect shared affinity; it does nothing solo.
Level it at Hydron on Sedna, Helene on Saturn or Elite Sanctuary Onslaught, where public squads are dense.
Slot Flawed melee mods while it is unranked to fit the low capacity.
Treat it as pure mastery fodder and do it whenever you clear the rank 30 backlog.
